datasets.name: ds_s2_daily
queryLines:
-- ds_s2_daily: per run day in the 30 days up to E and non-pass status, the number of rule results; days without runs have no rows (gaps).
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    e.e_date,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date)
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
        AND run_date < e.e_date
    ) AS p_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date) AS e_date
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
    ) e
),
res AS (
  SELECT
    r.*
  FROM
    v_simple_results r CROSS JOIN days d
  WHERE
    r.is_latest_for_day
    AND r.status_label IS NOT NULL
    AND r.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.e_date, 29) AND d.e_date
),
run_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    run_date
  FROM
    res
)
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', d.run_date) AS DATE) AS run_day,
  s.status_label,
  s.status_order,
  COUNT(r.status) AS result_count
FROM
  run_days d
    CROSS JOIN v_simple_status s
    LEFT JOIN res r
      ON r.run_date = d.run_date
      AND r.status = s.status
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  run_day,
  s.status_order

datasets.name: ds_s1_areas
queryLines:
-- ds_s1_areas: per project on E, rule results by non-pass status (bar segments) plus pass_count for the tooltip; worst project first.
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    e.e_date,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date)
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
        AND run_date < e.e_date
    ) AS p_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date) AS e_date
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
    ) e
),
res AS (
  SELECT
    r.*
  FROM
    v_simple_results r
      JOIN days d
        ON r.run_date = d.e_date
  WHERE
    r.is_latest_for_day
),
areas AS (
  SELECT
    project_label,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'error') AS area_errors,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'warning') AS area_warnings,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'code_error') AS area_code_errors,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'pass') AS pass_count
  FROM
    res
  GROUP BY
    project_label
)
SELECT
  a.project_label,
  s.status_label,
  s.status_order,
  COUNT(r.status) AS result_count,
  a.pass_count,
  a.area_errors,
  a.area_warnings,
  a.area_code_errors
FROM
  areas a
    CROSS JOIN v_simple_status s
    LEFT JOIN res r
      ON r.project_label = a.project_label
      AND r.status = s.status
GROUP BY
  ALL
ORDER BY
  a.area_errors DESC,
  a.area_warnings DESC,
  a.area_code_errors DESC,
  a.project_label,
  s.status_order

datasets.name: ds_s2_kpis
queryLines:
-- ds_s2_kpis: all-time numbers for page 2: executions ever, and Pass / Warning / Failure over all scored rule results (latest per rule and day).
WITH res AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    v_simple_results
  WHERE
    is_latest_for_day
    AND is_scored
),
months AS (
  SELECT
    array(
      'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'
    ) AS m
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*)
    FROM
      v_simple_executions
  ) AS executions,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'pass') AS pass_all,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'warning') AS warning_all,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'error') AS error_all,
  COUNT(*) AS scored_all,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'pass') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pass_pct_all,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'warning') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS warning_pct_all,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'error') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS error_pct_all,
  concat(
    element_at(MAX(mo.m), month(MIN(run_date))),
    ' ',
    year(MIN(run_date))
  ) AS first_run_month_label,
  -- pre-formatted subtitle lines 'X of N' (English number format)
  concat(format_number(COUNT_IF(status = 'pass'), 0), ' of ', format_number(COUNT(*), 0)) AS pass_sub_all,
  concat(format_number(COUNT_IF(status = 'warning'), 0), ' of ', format_number(COUNT(*), 0)) AS warning_sub_all,
  concat(format_number(COUNT_IF(status = 'error'), 0), ' of ', format_number(COUNT(*), 0)) AS error_sub_all
FROM
  res CROSS JOIN months mo

datasets.name: ds_s2_monthly
queryLines:
-- ds_s2_monthly: per month, share of scored rule results that were Αποτυχία and Προειδοποίηση; is_last_month marks the (possibly incomplete) last month.
WITH res AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    v_simple_results
  WHERE
    is_latest_for_day
    AND is_scored
),
m AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', run_date) AS DATE) AS run_month,
    status
  FROM
    res
)
SELECT
  m.run_month,
  s.status_label AS series_label,
  s.status_color,
  COUNT_IF(m.status = s.status) / COUNT(*) AS share,
  m.run_month = MAX(m.run_month) OVER () AS is_last_month
FROM
  m CROSS JOIN v_simple_status s
WHERE
  s.status IN ('error', 'warning', 'pass')
GROUP BY
  m.run_month,
  s.status_label,
  s.status_color,
  s.status_order
ORDER BY
  m.run_month,
  s.status_order

datasets.name: ds_s2_areas
queryLines:
-- ds_s2_areas: per project, its last run day, the worst status of that day, and Pass / Warning / Failure in the 7 days up to E; most errors first (projects).
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    e.e_date,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date)
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
        AND run_date < e.e_date
    ) AS p_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date) AS e_date
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
    ) e
),
res AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    v_simple_results
  WHERE
    is_latest_for_day
    AND status_label IS NOT NULL
),
last_day AS (
  SELECT
    project_label,
    MAX(run_date) AS last_day
  FROM
    res
  GROUP BY
    project_label
),
last_status AS (
  SELECT
    l.project_label,
    l.last_day,
    MIN(r.status_order) AS worst_order
  FROM
    last_day l
      JOIN res r
        ON r.project_label = l.project_label
        AND r.run_date = l.last_day
  GROUP BY
    l.project_label,
    l.last_day
),
week AS (
  SELECT
    r.project_label,
    COUNT_IF(r.status = 'pass') AS pass_7d,
    COUNT_IF(r.status = 'warning') AS warning_7d,
    COUNT_IF(r.status = 'error') AS error_7d
  FROM
    res r CROSS JOIN days d
  WHERE
    r.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.e_date, 6) AND d.e_date
  GROUP BY
    r.project_label
)
SELECT
  ls.project_label,
  ls.last_day,
  date_format(ls.last_day, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS last_day_label,
  concat(s.status_symbol, ' ', s.status_label) AS last_status_text,
  s.status_label AS last_status_label,
  COALESCE(w.pass_7d, 0) AS pass_7d,
  COALESCE(w.warning_7d, 0) AS warning_7d,
  COALESCE(w.error_7d, 0) AS error_7d,
  'Open →' AS open_text,
  url_encode(ls.project_label) AS project_url
FROM
  last_status ls
    JOIN v_simple_status s
      ON s.status_order = ls.worst_order
    LEFT JOIN week w
      ON w.project_label = ls.project_label
ORDER BY
  error_7d DESC,
  warning_7d DESC,
  ls.project_label

datasets.name: ds_s1_tables
queryLines:
-- ds_s1_tables: top 5 tables by failed rows on E (only > 0), with the table's worst status on E for the bar color.
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    e.e_date,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date)
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
        AND run_date < e.e_date
    ) AS p_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date) AS e_date
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
    ) e
)
SELECT
  t.table_label,
  t.project_label,
  t.status_label,
  t.status_order,
  COALESCE(t.rows_failed, 0) AS rows_failed,
  t.rows_evaluated,
  t.rows_failed / NULLIF(t.rows_evaluated, 0) AS failed_share
FROM
  v_simple_table_daily t
    JOIN days d
      ON t.run_date = d.e_date
WHERE
  COALESCE(t.rows_failed, 0) > 0
ORDER BY
  failed_share DESC,
  rows_failed DESC,
  t.status_order,
  t.table_label
LIMIT 5

datasets.name: ds_s1_kpis
queryLines:
-- ds_s1_kpis: one row with E, P and every page-1 tile value (E vs P); times in Athens time; N = rows of the data (per table MAX).
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    e.e_date,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date)
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
        AND run_date < e.e_date
    ) AS p_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date) AS e_date
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
    ) e
),
res AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    CASE
      WHEN r.run_date = d.e_date THEN 'E'
      ELSE 'P'
    END AS which
  FROM
    v_simple_results r CROSS JOIN days d
  WHERE
    r.is_latest_for_day
    AND r.run_date IN (d.e_date, d.p_date)
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'E'
      AND status = 'pass'
    ) AS pass_e,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'P'
      AND status = 'pass'
    ) AS pass_p,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'E'
      AND status = 'warning'
    ) AS warning_e,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'P'
      AND status = 'warning'
    ) AS warning_p,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'E'
      AND status = 'error'
    ) AS error_e,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'P'
      AND status = 'error'
    ) AS error_p,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'E'
      AND status = 'code_error'
    ) AS code_error_e,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'P'
      AND status = 'code_error'
    ) AS code_error_p,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'E'
      AND is_scored
    ) AS scored_e,
    COUNT_IF(
      which = 'E'
      AND status_label IS NOT NULL
    ) AS results_e,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          which = 'E'
          AND quarantine
          AND status IN ('warning', 'error')
        THEN
          COALESCE(rows_failed, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS quarantined_e,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          which = 'P'
          AND quarantine
          AND status IN ('warning', 'error')
        THEN
          COALESCE(rows_failed, 0)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS quarantined_p
  FROM
    res
),
data_rows AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(t.rows_evaluated) AS rows_evaluated_e
  FROM
    v_simple_table_daily t
      JOIN days d
        ON t.run_date = d.e_date
),
runs AS (
  SELECT
    from_utc_timestamp(MAX(x.end_timestamp), 'Europe/Athens') AS e_end_ts
  FROM
    v_simple_executions x
      JOIN days d
        ON x.run_date = d.e_date
)
SELECT
  d.e_date,
  d.p_date,
  date_format(d.e_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy') AS e_date_label,
  date_format(ru.e_end_ts, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS e_end_label,
  qe.score AS score_e,
  qp.score AS score_p,
  (qe.score - qp.score) * 100 AS score_change_points,
  COALESCE(qe.tables_scored, 0) AS tables_scored,
  COALESCE(qe.stale_tables, 0) AS stale_tables,
  c.pass_e,
  CASE
    WHEN d.p_date IS NOT NULL THEN c.pass_p
  END AS pass_p,
  c.warning_e,
  CASE
    WHEN d.p_date IS NOT NULL THEN c.warning_p
  END AS warning_p,
  c.error_e,
  CASE
    WHEN d.p_date IS NOT NULL THEN c.error_p
  END AS error_p,
  c.code_error_e,
  CASE
    WHEN d.p_date IS NOT NULL THEN c.code_error_p
  END AS code_error_p,
  c.scored_e,
  c.results_e,
  c.pass_e / NULLIF(c.scored_e, 0) AS pass_pct_e,
  c.warning_e / NULLIF(c.scored_e, 0) AS warning_pct_e,
  c.error_e / NULLIF(c.scored_e, 0) AS error_pct_e,
  c.code_error_e / NULLIF(c.results_e, 0) AS code_error_pct_e,
  COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) AS quarantined_e,
  CASE
    WHEN d.p_date IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0)
  END AS quarantined_p,
  COALESCE(dr.rows_evaluated_e, 0) AS rows_evaluated_e,
  c.quarantined_e / NULLIF(dr.rows_evaluated_e, 0) AS quarantined_pct_e,
  -- pre-formatted subtitle lines (English number format) for the counter templates
  concat(COALESCE(qe.tables_scored, 0), ' tables · ', COALESCE(qe.stale_tables, 0), ' left out (late)') AS score_sub,
  concat(COALESCE(format_number(c.pass_e * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.scored_e, 0), 1), '0.0'), '% of ', format_number(c.scored_e, 0), ' checks') AS pass_sub,
  concat(COALESCE(format_number(c.warning_e * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.scored_e, 0), 1), '0.0'), '% of ', format_number(c.scored_e, 0), ' checks') AS warning_sub,
  concat(COALESCE(format_number(c.error_e * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.scored_e, 0), 1), '0.0'), '% of ', format_number(c.scored_e, 0), ' checks') AS error_sub,
  concat(COALESCE(format_number(c.code_error_e * 100.0 / NULLIF(c.results_e, 0), 1), '0.0'), '% of ', format_number(c.results_e, 0), ' checks') AS code_error_sub,
  concat(COALESCE(format_number(COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(dr.rows_evaluated_e, 0), 2), '0.00'), '% of ', format_number(COALESCE(dr.rows_evaluated_e, 0), 0), ' rows') AS quarantine_sub,
  -- tile texts (style pass): value text, delta text, delta colour
  COALESCE(concat(format_number(qe.score * 100, 1), '%'), '—') AS score_txt,
  CASE WHEN qe.score IS NULL THEN '' WHEN qp.score IS NULL THEN 'no previous day' WHEN qe.score > qp.score THEN concat('▲ ', format_number((qe.score - qp.score) * 100, 1), ' pts from the previous day') WHEN qe.score < qp.score THEN concat('▼ ', format_number((qp.score - qe.score) * 100, 1), ' pts from the previous day') ELSE '= no change' END AS score_delta,
  CASE WHEN qp.score IS NULL OR qe.score = qp.score THEN '#8A8F98' WHEN qe.score > qp.score THEN '#2E8B57' ELSE '#D64545' END AS score_dcol,
  format_number(c.pass_e, 0) AS pass_txt,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL THEN 'no previous day' WHEN c.pass_e > c.pass_p THEN concat('▲ ', format_number(c.pass_e - c.pass_p, 0), ' from the previous day') WHEN c.pass_e < c.pass_p THEN concat('▼ ', format_number(c.pass_p - c.pass_e, 0), ' from the previous day') ELSE '= no change' END AS pass_delta,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL OR c.pass_e = c.pass_p THEN '#8A8F98' WHEN c.pass_e > c.pass_p THEN '#2E8B57' ELSE '#D64545' END AS pass_dcol,
  format_number(c.warning_e, 0) AS warning_txt,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL THEN 'no previous day' WHEN c.warning_e > c.warning_p THEN concat('▲ ', format_number(c.warning_e - c.warning_p, 0), ' from the previous day') WHEN c.warning_e < c.warning_p THEN concat('▼ ', format_number(c.warning_p - c.warning_e, 0), ' from the previous day') ELSE '= no change' END AS warning_delta,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL OR c.warning_e = c.warning_p THEN '#8A8F98' WHEN c.warning_e > c.warning_p THEN '#D64545' ELSE '#2E8B57' END AS warning_dcol,
  format_number(c.error_e, 0) AS error_txt,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL THEN 'no previous day' WHEN c.error_e > c.error_p THEN concat('▲ ', format_number(c.error_e - c.error_p, 0), ' from the previous day') WHEN c.error_e < c.error_p THEN concat('▼ ', format_number(c.error_p - c.error_e, 0), ' from the previous day') ELSE '= no change' END AS error_delta,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL OR c.error_e = c.error_p THEN '#8A8F98' WHEN c.error_e > c.error_p THEN '#D64545' ELSE '#2E8B57' END AS error_dcol,
  format_number(c.code_error_e, 0) AS code_error_txt,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL THEN 'no previous day' WHEN c.code_error_e > c.code_error_p THEN concat('▲ ', format_number(c.code_error_e - c.code_error_p, 0), ' from the previous day') WHEN c.code_error_e < c.code_error_p THEN concat('▼ ', format_number(c.code_error_p - c.code_error_e, 0), ' from the previous day') ELSE '= no change' END AS code_error_delta,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL OR c.code_error_e = c.code_error_p THEN '#8A8F98' WHEN c.code_error_e > c.code_error_p THEN '#D64545' ELSE '#2E8B57' END AS code_error_dcol,
  format_number(COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0), 0) AS quarantined_txt,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL THEN 'no previous day' WHEN COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) > COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0) THEN concat('▲ ', format_number(COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) - COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0), 0), ' from the previous day') WHEN COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) < COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0) THEN concat('▼ ', format_number(COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0) - COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0), 0), ' from the previous day') ELSE '= no change' END AS quarantined_delta,
  CASE WHEN d.p_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) = COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0) THEN '#8A8F98' WHEN COALESCE(c.quarantined_e, 0) > COALESCE(c.quarantined_p, 0) THEN '#D64545' ELSE '#2E8B57' END AS quarantined_dcol
FROM
  days d
    CROSS JOIN counts c
    CROSS JOIN data_rows dr
    CROSS JOIN runs ru
    LEFT JOIN v_simple_quality_score qe
      ON qe.k = 1
    LEFT JOIN v_simple_quality_score qp
      ON qp.k = 2

datasets.name: ds_s1_dimensions
queryLines:
-- ds_s1_dimensions: per kind of check on E, rule results by status and % passed; lowest % first, 'Unknown type' last.
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    e.e_date,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date)
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
        AND run_date < e.e_date
    ) AS p_date
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(run_date) AS e_date
      FROM
        v_simple_results
      WHERE
        result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
    ) e
),
res AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(r.dimension_label, 'Unknown type') AS dimension_label,
    r.dimension_label IS NULL AS is_unknown,
    r.status,
    r.is_scored
  FROM
    v_simple_results r
      JOIN days d
        ON r.run_date = d.e_date
  WHERE
    r.is_latest_for_day
    AND r.status_label IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  dimension_label,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'pass') AS pass_count,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'warning') AS warning_count,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'error') AS error_count,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'code_error') AS code_error_count,
  COUNT_IF(status = 'pass') / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(is_scored), 0) AS pass_pct,
  MAX(is_unknown) AS is_unknown
FROM
  res
GROUP BY
  dimension_label
ORDER BY
  is_unknown,
  pass_pct ASC NULLS LAST,
  dimension_label

datasets.name: ds_s3_daily
queryLines:
-- ds_s3_daily: per project and run day in the 30 days up to E, rule results by status (incl. Pass) with count and share of that day's results (same chart as 2.5, per project).
WITH e AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(run_date) AS e_date
  FROM
    v_simple_results
  WHERE
    result_rule_id IS NOT NULL
),
res AS (
  SELECT
    r.project_label,
    r.run_date,
    r.status
  FROM
    v_simple_results r CROSS JOIN e
  WHERE
    r.is_latest_for_day
    AND r.status_label IS NOT NULL
    AND r.run_date BETWEEN date_sub(e.e_date, 29) AND e.e_date
    AND r.project_label = :area
),
project_days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    project_label,
    run_date
  FROM
    res
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.project_label,
    CAST(d.run_date AS DATE) AS run_day,
    s.status_label,
    s.status_order,
    COUNT(r.status) AS result_count
  FROM
    project_days d
      CROSS JOIN v_simple_status s
      LEFT JOIN res r
        ON r.project_label = d.project_label
        AND r.run_date = d.run_date
        AND r.status = s.status
  GROUP BY
    ALL
)
SELECT
  project_label,
  run_day,
  status_label,
  status_order,
  result_count,
  result_count
    / NULLIF(SUM(result_count) OVER (PARTITION BY project_label, run_day), 0) AS result_pct
FROM
  counts
ORDER BY
  project_label,
  run_day,
  status_order

datasets.name: ds_s3_tables
queryLines:
-- ds_s3_tables: one row per table on its newest run day: worst status, consecutive run days WITHOUT Pass (window over v_simple_table_daily_ext), failed rows; feeds 3.1-3.3 and 3.5 (Project page).
-- Unknown table detected by key (table_id IS NULL), not by label. view_streak_runs = Eva's same-state streak, kept for comparison only.
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    t.*,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN t.worst_status = 'pass' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) OVER (
        PARTITION BY t.table_label
        ORDER BY t.run_date DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS pass_seen
  FROM
    v_simple_table_daily_ext t
),
streak AS (
  SELECT
    table_label,
    COUNT_IF(pass_seen = 0) AS np_runs,
    MIN(
      CASE
        WHEN pass_seen = 0 THEN run_date
      END
    ) AS np_start
  FROM
    d
  GROUP BY
    table_label
)
SELECT
  t.project_label,
  t.table_label,
  t.table_id IS NULL AS is_unknown,
  t.run_date AS last_day,
  t.worst_status,
  t.status_label,
  t.status_order,
  concat(t.status_symbol, ' ', t.status_label) AS last_status_text,
  COALESCE(s.np_runs, 0) AS streak_runs,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(s.np_runs, 0) = 0 THEN '—'
    ELSE CAST(s.np_runs AS STRING)
  END AS streak_text,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(s.np_runs, 0) = 0
      OR s.np_start IS NULL
    THEN
      '—'
    ELSE date_format(s.np_start, 'dd/MM')
  END AS streak_from,
  COALESCE(t.rows_failed, 0) AS rows_failed,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(t.rows_failed, 0) = 0 THEN '—'
    ELSE format_number(t.rows_failed, 0)
  END AS rows_failed_text,
  CASE
    WHEN t.worst_status = 'error' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_error,
  CASE
    WHEN t.worst_status = 'warning' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_warning,
  CASE
    WHEN t.worst_status = 'pass' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_pass,
  CASE
    WHEN t.worst_status = 'pass' THEN 0
    ELSE t.streak_runs
  END AS view_streak_runs,
  'Open →' AS open_text,
  url_encode(t.table_label) AS table_url
FROM
  v_simple_table_daily_ext t
    LEFT JOIN streak s
      ON s.table_label = t.table_label
WHERE
  t.day_rank = 1
  AND t.project_label = :area
ORDER BY
  is_unknown,
  t.status_order,
  rows_failed DESC,
  t.table_label

datasets.name: ds_s4_rules
queryLines:
-- ds_s4_rules: one row per rule assignment on its table's newest run day, with the 4.5 columns and rule_sort for the 4.4 pivot.
WITH newest AS (
  SELECT
    table_label,
    run_date


  FROM
    v_simple_table_daily_ext


  WHERE
    day_rank = 1
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    d.*


  FROM
    v_simple_rule_daily_ext d
      JOIN newest n
        ON n.table_label = d.table_label
        AND n.run_date = d.run_date


  WHERE
    d.rule_assignment_id IS NOT NULL
    AND d.table_label = :table
)
SELECT
  r.project_label,
  r.table_label,
  r.rule_assignment_id,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.table_label
      ORDER BY r.status_order, COALESCE(r.rows_failed, 0) DESC, r.rule_assignment_id
    ) AS rule_sort,
  concat(
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rule_description, ''), r.rule_name, 'Rule no longer exists'),
    CASE
      WHEN r.quarantine THEN ' · quarantine'
      ELSE ''
    END
  ) AS what_text,
  COALESCE(r.dimension_label, 'Unknown type') AS dimension_label,
  COALESCE(r.criticality_label, '—') AS criticality_label,
  concat(r.status_symbol, ' ', r.status_label) AS last_status_text,
  r.status_label,
  r.status_order,
  COALESCE(r.rows_failed, 0) AS rows_failed,
  CASE
    WHEN
      r.status IN ('warning', 'error')
      AND r.streak_start IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      date_format(r.streak_start, 'dd/MM')
    ELSE '—'
  END AS failing_since,
  COALESCE(r.rule_name, '—') AS rule_name,
  COALESCE(r.checked_columns, '—') AS checked_columns


FROM
  r
ORDER BY
  r.table_label,
  rule_sort

datasets.name: ds_s4_history
queryLines:
-- ds_s4_history: per rule assignment and each of its table's last 10 run days, the status cell for the 4.4 pivot (rows ordered like 4.5).
WITH days AS (
  SELECT
    table_label,
    run_date,
    day_rank


  FROM
    v_simple_table_daily_ext


  WHERE
    day_rank <= 10
),
newest AS (
  SELECT
    d.table_label,
    d.rule_assignment_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY d.table_label
        ORDER BY d.status_order, COALESCE(d.rows_failed, 0) DESC, d.rule_assignment_id
      ) AS rule_sort


  FROM
    v_simple_rule_daily_ext d
      JOIN days n
        ON n.table_label = d.table_label
        AND n.run_date = d.run_date
        AND n.day_rank = 1


  WHERE
    d.rule_assignment_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  r.project_label,
  r.table_label,
  r.rule_assignment_id,
  COALESCE(n.rule_sort, 1000 + r.rule_assignment_id) AS rule_sort,
  COALESCE(r.dimension_label, 'Unknown type') AS dimension_label,
  r.run_date,
  date_format(r.run_date, 'dd/MM') AS day_label,
  date_format(r.run_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS run_key,
  concat(r.status_symbol, ' ', r.status_label) AS cell_text,
  r.status_label,
  concat(
    COALESCE(NULLIF(r.rule_description, ''), r.rule_name, 'Rule no longer exists'),
    ' · ',
    date_format(r.run_date, 'dd/MM/yyyy'),
    ': ',
    r.status_label
  ) AS cell_tooltip


FROM
  v_simple_rule_daily_ext r
    JOIN days d
      ON d.table_label = r.table_label
      AND d.run_date = r.run_date
    LEFT JOIN newest n
      ON n.table_label = r.table_label
      AND n.rule_assignment_id = r.rule_assignment_id


WHERE
  r.rule_assignment_id IS NOT NULL
  AND r.table_label = :table
ORDER BY
  r.table_label,
  rule_sort,
  r.run_date

datasets.name: ds_s4_table_days
queryLines:
-- ds_s4_table_days: per table, its last 10 run days with failed and evaluated rows plus the active rule count; feeds 4.1-4.3.
SELECT
  t.project_label,
  t.table_label,
  t.run_date,
  t.day_rank,
  t.day_rank = 1 AS is_newest,
  t.day_rank = 2 AS is_previous,
  COALESCE(t.rows_failed, 0) AS rows_failed,
  COALESCE(t.rows_evaluated, 0) AS rows_evaluated,
  COALESCE(c.table_active_rule_count, 0) AS active_rule_count


FROM
  v_simple_table_daily_ext t
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        table_label,
        MAX(table_active_rule_count) AS table_active_rule_count


      FROM
        v_simple_coverage_ext


      GROUP BY
        table_label
    ) c
      ON c.table_label = t.table_label


WHERE
  t.day_rank <= 10
  AND t.table_label = :table
ORDER BY
  t.table_label,
  t.run_date

datasets.name: ds_s4_coverage
queryLines:
-- ds_s4_coverage: per table, one cell per ACTIVE dimension (metadata.rule_dimension.is_active) ('✓ N' or 'Missing'), plus the 'Key not checked' column, for the 4.6 pivot.
-- test_ui and Unknown type are shown only if they have at least one rule on some table.
WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    SUM(v.active_rule_count) OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(v.rule_dimension, '~none')
      ) AS dim_rules_total
  FROM
    v_simple_coverage_ext v
),
active_dims AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    rule_dimension
  FROM
    v_simple_active_dimension_ext
  WHERE
    is_active
)
SELECT
  c.project_label,
  c.table_label,
  COALESCE(c.dimension_label, 'Unknown type') AS column_label,
  CASE
    WHEN c.dimension_label IS NULL THEN 98
    ELSE 1
  END AS column_order,
  CASE
    WHEN c.active_rule_count > 0 THEN concat('✓ ', c.active_rule_count)
    ELSE 'Missing'
  END AS cell_text
FROM
  c
    LEFT JOIN active_dims a
      ON a.rule_dimension = c.rule_dimension
WHERE
  c.table_label = :table
  AND (
  (
    c.rule_dimension IS NULL
    AND c.dim_rules_total > 0
  )
  OR (
    a.rule_dimension IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      lower(c.rule_dimension) <> 'test_ui'
      OR c.dim_rules_total > 0
    )
  )
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT
  project_label,
  table_label,
  'Key not checked' AS column_label,
  99 AS column_order,
  CASE
    WHEN
      has_primary_key
      AND NOT has_uniqueness_rule
    THEN
      'Yes'
    ELSE '—'
  END AS cell_text
FROM
  c
WHERE
  table_label = :table
ORDER BY
  table_label,
  column_order,
  column_label

datasets.name: ds_opt_tables
queryLines:
-- ds_opt_tables: one row per table, values for the page-4 Table parameter; Unknown table last.
SELECT DISTINCT
  table_label,
  table_id IS NULL AS is_unknown
FROM
  v_simple_table_daily_ext
WHERE
  day_rank = 1
ORDER BY
  is_unknown,
  table_label
